title: Advanced Language Practice: Written French
prerequisites_raw: FRE282H5 or a minimum grade of 77% in FSL406H5 or the equivalent as determined by the department's French Language Placement Test ( https://frenchpt.utm.utoronto.ca/ ).
exclusions_raw: FSL420H1 or FSL422H1 . Not normally open to francophones and/or holders of the French baccalaureat but contingent on the results of the French Language Placement Test ( https://frenchpt.utm.utoronto.ca/ ).
